resources.string: Restores the \"Always allow to open\" checkbox in ColorOS app-jump confirmations — and it actually works.

When enabled, unauthorized app-to-app jumps show the native \"Always allow to open\" checkbox; checking it and allowing saves a long-term grant for caller → target. Payment-protection, mini-program and blacklist jumps keep native behavior.
Enable this module in LSPosed and check scope \"Permission manager (com.oplus.securitypermission)\".
When on, the launcher icon disappears. Restoring is unaffected: open LSPosed → Modules → this module\'s settings page (that entry is not the launcher icon) and turn this switch off again.

Compatibility is independent of the system version: works as long as the permission center keeps the \"version 2 → legacy dialog\" branch; verified on ColorOS 17 / Android 17. If the class or branch changes in later versions, the hook only logs failure. Modding has risks, back up first.
